answer: By the vault of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Every claim climbs the jade of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the tundra re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, converted to a slow vesting stream, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
